content.shortDescription: Mide tu porcentaje de ratio de endeudamiento sobre ingresos (DTI) y verifica si calificas para préstamos o hipotecas.
content.shortDescription_en: Measure your Debt-to-Income (DTI) ratio percentage and check if you qualify for bank loans or mortgages.
content.longDescription: Calcula el porcentaje de tus ingresos brutos mensuales destinado a saldar deudas recurrentes (hipoteca, coche, tarjetas, préstamos). Evaluado directamente por entidades bancarias.
content.longDescription_en: Calculate the percentage of gross monthly income spent on recurring monthly debt payments (mortgage, auto loans, credit cards, student debt).
howToUse: Añade la cuota de vivienda (alquiler o hipoteca).
Suma otros pagos mensuales de deudas (autos, tarjetas, préstamos).
Consulta tu ratio DTI % y la calificación de riesgo crediticio.
howToUse_en: Add monthly housing payment (rent or mortgage).
Add other recurring debt payments (auto, credit cards, student loans).
View your DTI % ratio and lender risk assessment rating.
content.methodology: Fórmula DTI: Ratio DTI (%) = (Pagos Mensuales Totales de Deuda / Ingreso Mensual Bruto) × 100.
content.methodology_en: DTI Formula: DTI Ratio (%) = (Total Monthly Debt Payments / Gross Monthly Income) × 100.

guideSections.title: What is Debt-to-Income (DTI) Ratio?
guideSections.title_es: ¿Qué es el Ratio de Endeudamiento DTI?
guideSections.content_html_en: DTI is a personal finance measure comparing an individual's monthly debt payment to their gross monthly income. Lenders use it to assess borrowing risk.
guideSections.content_html: El DTI compara tus pagos mensuales de deuda con tu ingreso bruto. Es el indicador clave que usan los bancos para aprobar créditos.

guideSections.title: DTI Benchmark Thresholds
guideSections.content_html_en:
• Under 36%: Healthy debt level. Qualified for most competitive loan rates.
  • 36% - 43%: Manageable, but approaching risk limits.
  • Over 43%: High risk. Difficult to qualify for traditional mortgages.
guideSections.content_html:
• Menos de 36%: Endeudamiento saludable. Aprobación bancaria fácil.
  • 36% - 43%: Manejable pero cercano al límite.
  • Más de 43%: Alto riesgo de sobreendeudamiento.
